## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Duolingo promo sheet over the dimmed learning path: SUPER duolingo rainbow logo, "Start 2026 with 60% off!", "Savings apply to the 12-month plan." and "Offer ends in 71h 59m" in green, a white "GET 60% OFF" button, and "SKIP OFFER" below. Sparkles: small 4-point starbursts and dots in pink, green, blue, white.

## Motion spec
Pattern: ambient looping sparkle field on a promo sheet.
- The sheet slides up on entry (350ms, ease-out) and the backdrop dims (250ms); contents fade in staggered top to bottom (logo, headline, terms, button, skip - 60ms apart, 200ms each).
- The sparkle loop runs continuously: every ~350ms a starburst pops at a random position in the sheet's upper 60% - flash in (scale 0 -> 1, 100ms), hold 150ms, fade-shrink out (250ms).
- Colors cycle pink -> green -> blue -> white with no immediate repeats; 20% of pops are tiny dots instead of stars.
- Occasionally (every ~2s) two sparkles pop within 100ms of each other - a double twinkle.
- The countdown ("71h 59m") ticks per minute with a soft digit roll (150ms).
- The button breathes very subtly (opacity 1 -> 0.92 -> 1, 3s) - the sparkles own the energy, not the CTA.

## Calibration
- Sparkles never land on the headline text or the button - the field is the background layer only.
- Never more than 3 sparkles alive at once; twinkle, not strobe.

## Reduced motion
One static sparkle arrangement; countdown swaps digits without rolling.

## Don't miss
- The offer timer is real and minute-accurate.
- The dimmed path behind the sheet stays fully still - no parallax.
